MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable 2TB drive feels like a useful next step after buying several camera memory cards because I could back up photos and files in one portable place.",
    "The HD Fire TV Stick gives my existing 720p television a practical new use through streaming alongside my DVD player."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The 4K streaming stick offers features my listed television cannot fully use, while the 16TB desktop drive goes beyond the storage need I can currently identify.",
    "Buying cables does not mean I need every connector type; the optical and RCA cables do not address a connection I currently need.",
    "Photography accessories do not imply a need for home surveillance, and owning a Fire tablet does not mean I want an Alexa speaker or another small display. A 24-port switch also has no clear role in my setup."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in smart devices, even though I usually choose accessories with a specific practical purpose.",
    "Storage and cable purchases seem to have been extended to much larger capacities and unrelated connectors without considering what I would actually use them for."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility matters to me: my television is 720p, and a cable is useful only when its connectors fit equipment I need to connect.",
    "My memory cards, reader, tripods and lens cap suggest an ongoing photography workflow, making manageable photo backup more relevant than surveillance or oversized desktop storage.",
    "I often buy accessories that support equipment I already own, so an additional device needs a clear purpose beyond overlapping with my tablet or television."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and entertainment needs but stretched my practical accessory purchases into unrelated devices and unnecessary capabilities."
}
